title: BNY builds “AI for everyone, everywhere” with OpenAI
summary: BNY uses OpenAI to expand AI adoption enterprise-wide through Eliza, where 20,000+ employees build AI agents that improve efficiency and client outcomes.
body: BNY uses OpenAI to expand AI adoption enterprise-wide through Eliza, where 20,000+ employees build AI agents that improve efficiency and client outcomes.
summaryZh: BNY与OpenAI达成合作，通过名为Eliza的平台在全企业范围内推广AI应用。目前已有超过2万名员工利用该平台构建AI代理，旨在提升工作效率并优化客户服务成果。此举标志着大型金融机构正从单一的聊天机器人应用转向更深度的企业级AI代理集成。

aiReview.reasonZh: BNY通过OpenAI平台推动企业级AI代理部署，展示了大型金融机构在AI应用落地方面的规模化实践。
